glosses: to be covered with (dust, snow, etc.)
to bear (e.g. someone's debts, faults, etc.)
to be fogged (due to overexposure, etc.)

exampleTranslations.1: I asked her who the man wearing the white hat was.
exampleTranslations.2: The machine was coated with dust.
exampleTranslations.3: Refugees will suffer lack of food, water, medicine and all that.
